primaryChecks.text: Gaal spoke again and said, “Behold, people are coming down by the middle of the land, and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: Then Zebul said to him, “Now where is your mouth, that you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Isn’t this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.”

wikipediaRead.supportingParaphraseJa: Meonenim項はJDG9:37のヘブライ語句 elon meonenim に対する訳語として「plain of Meonenim」「Elon-meonenim」「oak of Meonenim」「the Diviners’ Oak」を列挙する。後半二つは同じ句の訳語対応を直接支持するが、木の所在は特定しない。参照226もESV訳を“Diviners’ Oak”とする。
